evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: BIP 54 resolves long-standing consensus flaws including quadratic legacy sigops CPU exhaustion, CVE-2017-12842 64-byte transaction collisions, and timewarp attacks. Because this PR explicitly defines the deployment as inactive on mainnet, testnet, and signet, it serves as strategically important soft fork preparation and regtest test harness rather than an immediate mainnet security fix.
